judged_text: The save action's else-branch now calls group.create() with no usernames, so the controller's user-typed usernames are never transmitted during group creation, whereas the old flow called createWithUsernames(this.get('usernames')). An admin who types usernames into the selector before first saving a new group loses those entries: create() ignores usernames, the new group is saved with zero members, and no error or re-prompt appears — the input the user explicitly provided is silently dropped (the template also hides the add-members UI until id exists, so there is no path that preserves it).

adjudication.rationale: While the diff does change the save/create flow to call `group.save()` / `group.create()` without usernames, the new admin template (`admin/templates/group.hbs`) no longer renders any `user-selector` for members until `{{#if id}}` is true. That means during initial creation there is no UI path for an admin to type usernames “before first saving a new group”, so there are no entries to be silently dropped at creation time. Member additions are now done post-create via the explicit `addMembers` action and `Group#addMembers` API.
